description_zh: SUV（ego）在设有停车标志的路段直行，未能及时减速，追尾前方因停车标志减速至几乎停止的Waymo AV（v2）。选择SUV为ego以测试其能否避免追尾。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was traveling eastbound on 14th Street in autonomous mode when it slowed for a stop sign on Noe Street. As the Waymo AV slowed to almost a complete stop, an SUV made contact with the rear of the Waymo AV.
TYPE OF COLLISION: VEH 2: C. REAR END
MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: VEH 1: B. PROCEEDING STRAIGHT; VEH 2: B. PROCEEDING STRAIGHT
evidence.reason: 追尾事故，后车（SUV）的驾驶决策（未能及时刹车）最值得测试，故选为ego；前车减速至几乎停止，用front_brake表达，end_speed=0。
